LightningComponentBundle.description: Hero quick navigation tile for Home and App pages

property.name: tabApiName
property.label: Tab API Name
property.description: The API name of the tab to navigate to (e.g. Property__c).

property.name: labelName
property.label: Button & Tile Label
property.description: The display name of the target tab or action (e.g. Properties).

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Header Title
property.description: Optional header title for the card (e.g. Quick Navigation).

property.name: description
property.label: Description Subtitle
property.description: Help text or description displayed inside the tile.

property.name: iconName
property.label: SLDS Icon Name
property.description: SLDS icon name, e.g. custom:custom62 or standard:home (defaults to custom:custom62).

property.name: badgeText
property.label: Badge Label
property.description: Optional badge text displayed next to the title (e.g. Quick Link).
